items.source_title: Generative AI as an interactive learning environment in early childhood: preschool children's emerging AI literacy as socially distributed interpretive work in collaborative storytelling
items.source_locator: 出版社文章頁（管理者 2026-11-14 以瀏覽器存成 PDF；自動讀取回 Cloudflare 驗證頁）：Published online: 10 Nov 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2、3、4 句
items.original_excerpt: This qualitative case study examined whole-class AI-assisted storytelling in a public preschool in southeastern Türkiye. … The corpus consists of 17 Turkish transcript files from the episodes (involving 22 children aged 5–6 years), along with available video and image records. … In the individual episodes that were examined, the children treated the AI as an image producer, offered agentive explanations for unexpected outputs, and on occasion, linked features of the prompt to the resulting outputs.

items.original_excerpt: This protocol describes a two-arm cluster-randomised trial in schools that follow the Cambridge Lower Secondary Mathematics framework. … Grade 8 mathematics teachers will be randomised within schools to AIMAS-8, a system that combines a concept-level dynamic Bayesian learner model, prerequisite-aware item selection and expert-authored misconception feedback, or to the same items delivered in a fixed order with worked solutions. … Both arms receive twelve 30 min sessions on linear relationships. … No participant data have been collected.

items.original_excerpt: This study aims to develop and validate the Human–AI Collaboration Competency (HACC) Scale, which can be used to assess students’ perceived competency in allocating roles and managing tasks, and sharing, coordinating, and integrating with AI through ongoing interaction to achieve a common goal. … Two independent samples of high school students were used to examine the factor structures: Sample 1 (n = 195) was used for exploratory factor analysis (EFA), and Sample 2 (n = 356) was used for confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). … The final version of the HACC Scale consisted of 25 items loaded onto 5 factors.

items.original_excerpt: 「115年度總統盃AI素養爭霸賽」全國競賽(觀賽)暨頒獎典禮，今（13）日於臺北世貿一館圓滿閉幕。 … 正式賽共設有國小一般組、國小偏鄉組、國中一般組、國中偏鄉組共四組，另設有表演組。 … 全國共計201支隊伍、384名國中小學生參加。 … 10月28日於各縣市會場舉行的AI模型訓練，需於限時內完成資料蒐集、模型建置與策略調整等高難度挑戰，這些隊伍訓練出來的AI模型，經過評審小組審核，以及預選賽等過程，總計有80支隊伍，計152名選手晉級今日總決賽，共同角逐今日全國總冠軍的最高榮耀。 … 正式賽採用了「魷來魷去對戰版本」監督式學習遊戲，表演賽則採用了「Proly定向越野大作戰」強化式學習遊戲，提供多元的競賽遊戲選擇。

items.original_excerpt: This exploratory study examined regional differences in observed self-reported composite scores for pedagogical use of AI, educational data management, and adaptation and inclusion among 334 teachers in Ecuador with prior AI experience. … Using a cross-sectional design with convenience and chain-referral sampling, data were collected from 2 June to 1 July 2026. … Each score averaged three five-point Likert-type items (Cronbach’s α = 0.861–0.890).

items.source_locator: 出版社文章頁截圖（管理者 2026-11-14 提供；自動讀取回 Cloudflare 驗證頁）：Published online: 12 Nov 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2、3、4、7、8 句
items.original_excerpt: This study examines task-selective AI integration by separating task-use presence from conditional task-use frequency. … Data were obtained from 187 public basic-school headteachers in three contexts in Ghana’s Ashanti Region who reported professional AI use during the previous six months. … Responses to 11 leadership activities produced 2,057 headteacher-task observations. … Reported information and communication technology (ICT)/digital training was positively associated with both margins. … Reported AI-specific training was associated only with conditional frequency, while self-reported AI literacy did not independently differentiate either margin.
